items.question: How do payments work?
items.answer: NGN offers use prepaid credit purchases. USD offers include recurring plans and one-time credit packs. Check the price and billing terms for your selected offer before paying.

items.question: Do credits expire or roll over?
items.answer: Validity depends on the offer. Unused credits can accumulate, but they remain subject to its validity terms. A new credit grant can change the expiry date of your whole account balance.

items.question: What uses a credit?
items.answer: Paper grading uses one credit per submitted learner script. Generating a CBT quiz uses 15 credits. Credits are not a count of learners, courses or unlimited assessments; different actions consume credits.

items.question: Do I need a school account?
items.answer: No. Choose Tutor or trainer when you run your own assessments, or Teaching team or institution for a shared setup. You must have permission to process the work you upload.

faq.heading: Questions before your next assessment
faq.body: Find the details you need to choose your workflow.

items.question: Can I use GradrAI for paper and online tests?
items.answer: Yes. GradrAI supports paper-based and computer-based assessment workflows. We can discuss how your subject, question types and marking guide fit the workflow.

items.question: Can I use my own marking guide?
items.answer: Yes. Provide your criteria, mark allocations and acceptable approaches. Include any partial-credit or follow-through rules so you can review how they are applied.

items.question: Can I review or change the marks?
items.answer: Yes. You can inspect scores and explanations and amend results where needed. Check AI-generated marks against the student’s work before using them for final grades. Learners should discuss scoring concerns with their instructor.

items.question: What can students do with SmartPrep?
items.answer: Students can practise selected subjects, check their answers and read explanations after a session. Use those results to decide what to revisit.

items.question: How long does marking take?
items.answer: Timing depends on the number and legibility of scripts, the assessment complexity, processing mode and review work. We can discuss a realistic turnaround for your workflow during a demo.

items.question: Can GradrAI work with limited internet access?
items.answer: Ask us about desktop and local-network assessment options for low-connectivity settings. Availability and internet requirements depend on the workflow, devices and AI features you use.

items.question: How is student data handled?
items.answer: Assessment workflows can involve external cloud service providers. Read our Privacy Policy and discuss your institution’s processing, access, retention and deletion requirements with us before uploading student work.

items.question: What do browser exam controls do?
items.answer: Strict browser-based exams use fullscreen and focus checks. Leaving the exam window or fullscreen can submit the attempt. These signals are not proof of cheating; agree settings and accommodations with staff before the exam.
